name: Saves in Documents (mirror)
author: Max (byzyn4ik)
description: Forza Horizon 2's saves in Documents\My Games\<game>\Saves\<title>. Under forza_injector the game loads and stores them there (Mode=Auto turns on forza-injector.ini [Saves] Location=Documents); otherwise a verified copy of every save is kept there while the game uses Azimuth's own folder, which the plugin only reads and never deletes anything in.
